subject: using p value cut-off in calculateDiffMeth

messages.author: e466badf1c085931
messages.subject: using p value cut-off in calculateDiffMeth
parts:
Hi,

I want to use a p-value cut-off to get statistically significant DMRs. I have 3 test and 3 control datasets which I pooled into 1 dataset per test and per control and would like to know how to tell calculateDiffMeth to use p-value cut-offs rather than q-value cut-off. Can you help me with this. Thanks
Sumithra

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] using p value cut-off in calculateDiffMeth
parts:
Hi Sumithra,
You should be able to subset methylDiff object based on its columns with the most recent version of methylKit, so something like this should work (obj is a methylDiff object):

new.obj=obj[obj$pvalue<0.05 & abs(obj$meth.diff) > 25,]
